question: Can a learned GRPO/System-One critique-reconstruct adapter trained only on synthetic orthogonal train split (3 seeds, model-derived calibrated confidence, no oracle alias_family/query_key/target_prefix/header_key/body_field/auth_scope) match the rule-based proxy on synthetic orthogonal header/body/auth alias-OOD within 0.10 correct and 0.05 ECE as a validation gate, and if gate passes, generalize to live-browser WebShop/ALFWorld at BrowserGym 0.14.3 1280x720 with real CDP AX trees on header/body/auth aliasing including mixed multi-channel (header+body+query) within one request and production-SPA heterogeneity, preserving alias-OOD correct>=0.50 (binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10, McNemar p<0.05 vs exact matcher), false_accept<=0.15 (>=0.15 below verbatim replay p<0.05), exact-match>=0.90, UNKNOWN precision>=0.85, ECE<=0.15, with reported training cost/stability and retrieval+reconstruction+verification economics vs rule proxy and vs RAG, sequenced as synthetic gate before live evaluation?
hypothesis: A learned GRPO/System-One critique-reconstruct adapter trained exclusively on the synthetic orthogonal single-channel train split (header ApiKey/X-Reset-Token, body JSON field apiKey/key, auth permission families; not on held-out-3 variations, not on mixed multi-channel, not on live BrowserGym) to map (intent, observation-derived state from DOM/AX at 1280x720 or synthetic URL/header/body dict, retrieved_template/candidates) -> reconstructed template/bound_action with model-derived calibrated confidence (softmax/budget-derived, not hardcoded, gated UNKNOWN when max_score<0.80, std>0.05) will (H1 SYNTHETIC GATE) match the genuine rule-based structural proxy within 0.10 absolute on synthetic pooled alias-OOD correct (40 tasks: 30 orthogonal +10 mixed) and within 0.05 on ECE (5 bins, bootstrap 2000), with orthogonal subset correct>=0.50 and mixed subset correct>=0.40, and (H2 LIVE CONDITIONAL on gate pass) generalize to live-browser WebShop/ALFWorld at BrowserGym 0.14.3 1280x720 with real CDP AX trees on header/body/auth aliasing including 10 mixed multi-channel tasks (header+body+query jointly within one request) and production-SPA heterogeneity, achieving live alias-OOD correct>=0.50 with binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 and McNemar p<0.05 vs B-EXACT-MATCH (expected 0/50), false_accept<=0.15 and >=0.15 below B-VERBATIM-REPLAY with McNemar p<0.05, while preserving exact-match >=0.90 and no-applicable UNKNOWN precision>=0.85 with ECE<=0.15. Training cost/stability (wall-clock, tokens/calls, per-seed variance/CV across 3 seeds 42,43,44) and retrieval+reconstruction+verification economics vs rule proxy and vs TFIDF/embed RAG will be reported. Rule proxy alone already achieves 40/40 1.0 pooled (audit PASS, minimal derived dict, generic choose_adoptions+rewrite_template_multi) but learnability and live mixed-channel generalization are the dominant unknowns; sequencing gate avoids live burn if learned fails synthetic.
falsifier: Controls PASS required for any SURVIVES/FALSIFIES. SYNTHETIC GATE FALSIFIED (LEARNED falsified, RULE may still SURVIVE) if LEARNED pooled alias-OOD correct >0.15 below RULE or pooled correct <0.50 or binomial vs 0.10 p>=0.05 or McNemar vs B-EXACT-MATCH p>=0.05, or orthogonal subset <0.40, or ECE exceeds RULE by >0.10 (or ECE>0.25) or CV>0.5 across 3 seeds (42,43,44) or confidence std<=0.05 (hardcoded). POOLED SYNTHETIC FALSIFIED (both RULE and LEARNED) if RECONSTRUCTION-RULE pooled correct <0.50 or binomial p>=0.05 or McNemar vs B-EXACT-MATCH p>=0.05 or pooled <0.40 absolute, or mixed diagnostic: mixed 10/10 correct <0.30 with pooled <0.50 triggers bounded composition falsification, or false_accept>0.25 or not >=0.15 below verbatim (McNemar p>=0.05), or exact-match <0.85, or no-applicable precision<0.70 or ECE>0.25, or not dominated by retrieval (>0.10 below best RAG). LIVE CONDITIONAL FALSIFIED if N_live>=20 and PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH passes (80% healthy loads, AX nodes>10) but live pooled correct <0.40 or false_accept>0.25 or not >=0.15 below verbatim. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST requires synthetic pooled S1-S7 plus LEARNED gate within 0.10/0.05 and stability CV<=0.5 and live conditional gates when N_live>=20 report same S1-S2. Live exploratory (N_live<20 or PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH<80%) bounds claim to synthetic pooled+mixed with disclosure, not MEASUREMENT_INVALID. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if PC-EXACT-MATCH fails (correct<0.90 or false>0.10 on exact 12) or NC-NO-APPLICABLE/NC-EMPTY fails (precision<0.90 or false>0.10 or not 100% UNKNOWN), oracle leak detected (derived_context contains forbidden keys alias_family/query_key/target_prefix/routing_prefix/target_style/path_style/header_key/body_field/auth_scope/expected_template or hardcoded constant confidence), pooled alias-OOD N<32 (minimum 40, 32 absolute floor), >20% harness errors, or registry leak >0/40.
baselines: B-EXACT-MATCH (current SPIDER kernel): SpiderKernel.resolve with L97 exact intent equality, min_confidence 0.8, candidates sorted by confidence. Prior 0/40 alias-OOD pooled, expected 0/50 with live. ID B-EXACT-MATCH.

B-VERBATIM-REPLAY: Retrieve top-1 mechanism by exact intent equality scan in registry order; replay stored action_template verbatim via _bind without critique/rewriting. Aborts only if required_slots missing. Measures negative-transfer harm. Expected false_accept 1.0 on alias-OOD. ID B-VERBATIM-REPLAY.
B-RAG-TFIDF: TF-IDF retriever over mechanism intent+template strings; retrieve top-1 then verbatim bind. Tests retrieval alone. Fit only on train registry. Prior 0/40 pooled. ID B-RAG-TFIDF.

B-RAG-EMBED (strong retrieval): Sentence-transformer embedding cosine (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 or equivalent offline) retriever over intent+template; top-1 then verbatim bind. If unavailable offline deterministic, mark unavailable and use B-RAG-TFIDF as strong baseline with disclosure. Never uses ground-truth context signals. ID B-RAG-EMBED.
B-RANDOM: Uniform random among registry mechanisms whose intent matches and required_slots satisfied; else UNKNOWN. Chance-level baseline. ID B-RANDOM.

RECONSTRUCTION-RULE (genuine rule-based proxy): Deterministic structural scorer+rewriter conditioned only on (intent, observation-derived state from real DOM/AX tree or synthetic URL/header/body dict, retrieved_template/candidates) that scores slot count, path segments, query/header/body key presence and rewrites path<->query/header/body/auth including mixed multi-channel via generic adopt-any-observed-key-not-in-registry + rewrite_template_multi (alphabetically-sorted multi-adoption) before _bind; confidence = softmax over candidate scores (temp 0.15) + deterministic jitter gated UNKNOWN<0.80. No hidden_expected access. Prior 40/40 pooled 1.0. ID RECONSTRUCTION-RULE.

RECONSTRUCTION-LEARNED (GRPO/System-One): Learned critique-reconstruct adapter trained via GRPO or System-One scoring/budget exclusively on synthetic orthogonal train split (not on held-out-3 variations, not on mixed stratum, not on live BrowserGym) to map (intent, observation-derived state, retrieved_template) -> reconstructed template/bound_action with model-derived calibrated confidence; gated UNKNOWN<0.80. Confidence must vary (std>0.05). Report training cost/stability vs rule proxy across 3 seeds 42,43,44. GRPO reward = correct - false_accept penalty + calibration bonus. ID RECONSTRUCTION-LEARNED.
positive_control: PC-EXACT-MATCH: On exact-match stratum (N>=12 tasks where test intent equals registry intent verbatim, same slot names, preconditions match, no aliasing), all applicable methods (B-EXACT-MATCH, RECONSTRUCTION-RULE, and if available RECONSTRUCTION-LEARNED) must achieve correct_resolution >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10 with no crashes. Verifies pipeline resolves when no adaptation required. ID PC-EXACT-MATCH. PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH (exploratory gating): At least 80% of attempted live BrowserGym tasks must load DOM/AX tree at 1280x720 without truncation/timeout (CDP AX tree nodes>10, url and method observed). If <80% healthy, live stratum is exploratory and claim bounds to synthetic pooled+mixed only, not MEASUREMENT_INVALID. ID PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH.
null_control: NC-NO-APPLICABLE: On no-applicable stratum (N>=12 tasks where test intent is OOD with no covering mechanism) every method must return UNKNOWN (or gated confidence<0.80) with UNKNOWN precision >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10. NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY: Empty registry (N>=6) with any intent returns UNKNOWN 100% (validates kernel does not hallucinate). Failure indicates hallucination/miscalibration, triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID. IDs NC-NO-APPLICABLE, NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY.
measurement_validity: Registry construction: For each synthetic orthogonal alias-OOD task, registry contains exactly one training mechanism (from alias train template) + one distractor alias template with equal confidence 0.9 + one exact-match distractor at 0.8, all preconditions={} guards={} to isolate aliasing. Test query uses held-out alias form with same semantic intent string as training (exact matcher failure due to template aliasing requiring reconstruction, not intent mismatch). No test template appears verbatim in registry (0/40 synthetic pooled leakage: 30 orthogonal +10 mixed; same for live if available). Mixed multi-channel tasks: registry training mechanism uses single-channel form, test requires simultaneous header+body+query rewriting within one bound_action. Live BrowserGym tasks: sampled via BrowserGym 0.14.3 WebShop/ALFWorld at 1280x720; registry built from training trajectories, test tasks are held-out goal variations with aliased endpoint/field manifestation in observed AX/DOM; no test live template verbatim in registry. Preprocessing fit on TRAIN only.

State representation - genuine non-oracle with BrowserGym 1280x720: context dict provided to resolve/reconstruction contains ONLY observation-derived fields from real browser state: url (observed string at 1280x720), method, url_path, url_query dict, url_segments, headers_observed dict, body_observed (JSON/string if available), ax_tree_snapshot (CDP AX tree text snapshot hash and truncated 2k tokens for parsing, viewport 1280x720), and intent string. It MUST NOT contain ground-truth fixture signals alias_family, query_key, target_prefix, routing_prefix, target_style, path_style, header_key, body_field, auth_scope, expected_template or any field encoding alias answer. Those keys, if needed for scoring, stored separately as hidden_expected metadata not passed to any method. Synthetic orthogonal+mixed tasks use minimal derived dict without AX tree to isolate orthogonal alias mechanism plus mixed credit; live tasks use full AX-derived dict.

Action representation: Mechanism action_template is string template containing ${slot} parameters in URL path, query param, header value (e.g., ApiKey: ${token} or X-Reset-Token: ${token}), body JSON field, or auth scope, and for mixed tasks simultaneously header+body+query slots. Binding via deterministic kernel _bind plus header/body field substitution. Genuine reconstruction may score each candidate template's structural match to observation-derived state and/or rewrite template structure before _bind conditioned ONLY on (intent, observation-derived state, retrieved_template/candidates). Rewriter deterministic for RULE (must handle mixed multi-channel generically via alphabetically-sorted adopt-any-observed-key-not-in-registry + multi-field rewrite); learned for LEARNED. No hidden_expected access. Confidence must be derived from normalized structural score (softmax over candidates or rewrite confidence, temp 0.15) and gated UNKNOWN at <0.80 for ECE; constant 0.95/0.05 hardcoding triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

Orthogonal alias families, mixed multi-channel, and held-out: Synthetic orthogonal 30 tasks = 3 families x10 intents: (a) header-based (ApiKey vs X-Reset-Token vs Authorization Bearer aliasing), (b) body JSON field (apiKey vs key vs api_key vs token), (c) auth permission (scope read vs admin_scope vs permission header). Each family 7 standard +3 held-out variations (novel header X-Api-Key, body field api_token, permission X-Scope) not in rewrite table requiring generalization via key/segment analysis. Report overall 10/family and held-out-9 subset. Mixed multi-channel 10 tasks where aliasing spans header+body+query within one request (header ApiKey + body apiKey + query permission simultaneously aliased to X-Api-Key + body key + header X-Scope), requiring joint multi-field rewriting; trained only on single-channel examples to test compositional generalization. Live BrowserGym WebShop/ALFWorld: attempt 20+20 tasks with analogous header/body/query aliasing manifested in real request headers/body or URL aliasing observed in AX/DOM; add 10 live mixed tasks if feasible; exploratory if fewer. Production-SPA heterogeneity disclosed via BrowserGym viewport and AX diversity.

Learned GRPO/System-One training protocol (sequenced gate): LEARNED adapter trained exclusively on synthetic orthogonal train split (not on held-out-3 variations, not on mixed stratum, not on any live BrowserGym task). Training uses 3 seeds (42,43,44) for stability; report per-seed alias-OOD correct (pooled 40, orthogonal 30, mixed 10), ECE, variance, wall-clock seconds, LLM calls/tokens if any, and convergence. Synthetic gate evaluated first: if LEARNED fails gate (>0.15 below RULE or ECE>0.10 above RULE or CV>0.5), live evaluation is withheld/declared exploratory to avoid wasted browser compute; result is FALSIFIED for learned gate with disclosure. If offline LLM unavailable, mark LEARNED unavailable and report RULE vs RAG only with disclosure; do not fabricate learned metrics. Confidence for LEARNED must be model-derived and vary across tasks (std>0.05), not constant. GRPO reward = correct - false_accept penalty + calibration bonus; System-One budget = scoring inference steps.

Determinism and seeds: All RNG via numpy.random.RandomState(seed=42) and Python random.seed(42) unless LEARNED seed 42/43/44 for stability reporting; no unseeded calls. BrowserGym Playwright viewport fixed 1280x720, CDP AX tree collection deterministic. Embedding retriever deterministic normalized embeddings. Each task evaluated once per method (paired design); bootstrap resampling for CIs uses block-permutation over tasks (2000 resamples) respecting trajectory grouping if live tasks grouped by site/session.

Holdout and leakage controls: All alias families and mixed stratum stratified; train never sees test alias form nor mixed composition (verify 0/40 synthetic pooled templates appear verbatim in registry; same for live if available). TF-IDF/embedding fit on train registry only. Reconstruction rule/learned model derived from training alias documentation only; held-out forms and mixed compositions require structural generalization. Audit checks no method accesses hidden_expected or test-template verbatim except via observation parsing. Registry intent-equality leak verified 0/40. Live tasks split by website (WebShop vs ALFWorld) with no site identity leakage into retriever.

Sample counts (minimum discriminating, sequenced): Synthetic alias-OOD 30 orthogonal (10 per family incl 3 held-out) +10 mixed =40 pooled, exact-match 12, no-applicable 12, empty-registry 6 =70 synthetic tasks per method x7 methods =490 calls. Live BrowserGym: conditional on synthetic LEARNED gate pass and PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH >=80%; attempt 20 WebShop +20 ALFWorld =40 tasks +10 live mixed if feasible per method if accessible (up to 50x7=350 calls); exploratory only - if unavailable or >50% truncation/failed loads, mark exploratory and bound confirmatory claim to synthetic pooled+mixed with disclosure. Overall alias-OOD N>=40 required for confirmatory binomial/McNemar power (minimum 32 if live/mixed partially unavailable with disclosure); live stratum reported separately with Wilson CIs. Domain shift is exploratory.

Blinding and oracle prohibition: Genuine adapters not tuned on test alias forms nor on mixed compositions; held-out variations and mixed stratum excluded from mapping table and from LEARNED training data. Context forbidden keys filtered at harness level before resolve call (derive_state from observed URL/headers/body/AX, not from fixture). Harness exposes reconstruct_resolve(intent, derived_context, retrieved_candidates, params) signature. Mixed tasks audit that rewriter does not memorize mixed template but composes single-channel rewrites. Sequencing does not leak test signals into training.

Verification and metrics: correct_resolution = resolved template binds to URL/header/body that verifies against expected postcondition (hidden_expected_template bound equality including header/body field equality and for mixed all channels jointly correct); false_accept = resolved to wrong template or bound incorrectly or should have abstained; UNKNOWN = correctly abstained when no applicable mechanism or gated confidence<0.80. All three sum to 1.0 per stratum. Calibration via ECE over 5 confidence bins (confidence derived from structural/model score) plus abstention precision/recall; Wilson 95% CI for rates; one-sided binomial vs 0.10; McNemar paired for reconstruction vs exact and vs verbatim; bootstrap ECE CI (2000 resamples, trajectory-grouped if live). Training cost/stability and verification-boundary economics reported as exploratory secondary metrics: train wall-clock, tokens/calls, stability std/CV across 3 seeds, retrieval+reconstruction+verification steps per task and amortized cost vs RAG and vs verbatim; they do not gate SURVIVES for RULE but gate LEARNED non-inferiority. Mixed stratum reported separately plus pooled alias-OOD. Sequenced gate metric is LEARNED pooled correct within 0.10 of RULE and ECE within 0.05.

Oracle prohibition auditability: Harness code must expose reconstruct_resolve functions for RULE and LEARNED that take only (intent, derived_context, retrieved_candidates, params) where derived_context excludes forbidden keys. Confidence derivation inspectable (score computation visible). Reading task alias_family etc. or constant confidence triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID per parent audit fixes. Mixed stratum code inspection verifies compositional rewriting not memorized mixed fixture. Training logs for LEARNED must show train split contains 0/10 mixed templates and 0/9 held-out forms.
decision_rule: All primary thresholds on synthetic pooled alias-OOD (N>=40: 30 orthogonal +10 mixed) unless stated; live BrowserGym conditional on synthetic LEARNED gate pass and PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH >=80%. Compute per-method correct_resolution, false_accept, UNKNOWN rates with Wilson 95% CI; paired McNemar for reconstruction vs B-EXACT-MATCH (correct) and vs B-VERBATIM-REPLAY (false_accept); one-sided binomial vs 0.10 null; bootstrap block-permutation ECE CI (2000 resamples, trajectory-grouped if live). SEQUENCED SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST iff ALL hold: (G0 SYNTHETIC GATE) RECONSTRUCTION-LEARNED pooled correct within 0.10 of RECONSTRUCTION-RULE (RULE pooled - LEARNED pooled <=0.10) AND LEARNED ECE within 0.05 of RULE ECE AND LEARNED stability CV<=0.5 across 3 seeds and confidence std>0.05 and LEARNED pooled correct>=0.50 with binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 and McNemar p<0.05 vs B-EXACT-MATCH; (1) PC-EXACT-MATCH passes (correct >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10 for B-EXACT-MATCH and RECONSTRUCTION-RULE on exact-match stratum, LEARNED if available >=0.85), (2) NC-NO-APPLICABLE passes (UNKNOWN precision >=0.90 and false_accept <=0.10) AND NC-EMPTY 100% UNKNOWN, (3) alias-OOD pooled S1: RECONSTRUCTION-RULE pooled correct >=0.50 AND binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 AND McNemar p<0.05 vs B-EXACT-MATCH (expected 0/40), and orthogonal subset correct >=0.50 and mixed subset correct >=0.40 diagnostic (mixed <0.40 triggers bounded composition falsification even if pooled passes), and LEARNED also S1 if gate evaluated, (4) S2: RECONSTRUCTION-RULE false_accept <=0.15 AND strictly below B-VERBATIM-REPLAY by >=0.15 absolute with McNemar p<0.05 on false_accept (LEARNED also <=0.15 and below verbatim if available), (5) S3: reconstruction exact-match stratum correct >=0.90 for both RULE and if LEARNED available also >=0.85 (no regression), (6) S4: reconstruction no-applicable precision >=0.85 AND ECE <=0.15 (5 bins, derived confidence) for RULE and LEARNED ECE<=0.15 separately, (7) not dominated by retrieval: RECONSTRUCTION-RULE pooled correct not >0.10 below best RAG (TFIDF/embed) verbatim correct on same alias-OOD, LEARNED also not >0.10 below best RAG. LIVE CONDITIONAL CONFIRMATION (if N_live>=20 and PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH passes and G0 passes): report same S1-S2 on live pooled (orthogonal+mixed) with live alias-OOD correct >=0.50 (binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10) and false_accept <=0.15 (>=0.15 below verbatim); synthesis SURVIVES with live requires synthetic G0+S1-S7 plus live S1-S2. If live N_live<20 or PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH fails or G0 fails, bound claim to synthetic pooled+mixed with disclosure (not MEASUREMENT_INVALID). FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if controls pass but G0 fails by >0.15 correct or >0.10 ECE or CV>0.5 (LEARNED falsified, RULE may still be judged on S1-S7 alone for synthetic ceiling), or pooled S1 fails (correct<0.40) or mixed <0.30 with pooled <0.50, or S2 fails (false>0.25 or not below verbatim), or S3/S4 fails. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if PC or NC fails, oracle leak or constant confidence detected, pooled N<32, >20% harness errors, registry leak >0, or systematic BrowserGym load failure mislabeled as falsification.
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES with G0 gate pass and synthetic pooled orthogonal+mixed gates plus live BrowserGym conditional gates with calibration and learned non-inferiority within 0.10/0.05 and CV<=0.5 and stability reported: Genuine non-oracle reconstruction/adaptation beyond URL path/query to orthogonal header/body/auth aliasing including mixed multi-channel composition generalizes to live-browser WebShop/ALFWorld with calibrated abstention, demonstrating learnable GRPO/System-One can replace hand-coded rules. Product should add reconstruction layer after retrieval (critique-reconstruct conditioned on intent+observation-derived state from DOM/AX at 1280x720+retrieved template, joint multi-channel, confidence-gated UNKNOWN<0.80) before execution, with verification/repair boundary and freshness guard. Unblocks cross-site parameterized transfer where header/body/auth aliasing is common (addresses MemHarness negative-transfer), enables sequencing to workflow-compilation (Artic/FlowSearcher), and justifies kernelizing learned adapter with reported economics. Frontier C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE advances to EXPERIMENTAL bounded to genuine reconstruction on tested orthogonal families plus mixed composition and live BrowserGym with calibrated UNKNOWN, both rule and learned when non-inferior - not PRODUCT_CORE until end-to-end economics replicate at scale. Report economics: retrieval+reconstruction+verification cost per successful task vs RAG vs verbatim; training cost/stability vs rule proxy; if LEARNED unavailable but RULE SURVIVES, product may ship rule-based proxy as interim with disclosure.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED at G0 (learned gate) or at pooled S1/S2/S4 or at mixed composition or at live conditional: Genuine state-conditioned structural reconstruction does not beat exact matcher/verbatim on controlled orthogonal aliasing or learned variant fails to match rule proxy (>0.15 gap or >0.10 ECE or CV>0.5) or fails to generalize to live BrowserGym (correct<0.40 or false>0.25). Product must NOT add learned reconstruction layer for these families/compositions/live; keep exact-intent matching and require agents to supply exact intents or pre-normalized templates; prioritize explicit alias catalogs, server-side routing normalization, or per-site header/body mapping tables. If RULE SURVIVES but LEARNED fails gate, product may keep rule-based proxy but cannot claim learned replaceability; training instability or synthetic-to-real gap is identified, not blanket rejection of critique-reconstruct class. Frontier mechanism closed for this learned adapter class and families incl held-out/mixed/live; next Frontier attack should test orthogonal basin (artifact-driven workflow compilation, hierarchical DAG synthesis, program-synthesis repair, cache invalidation, incremental computation) rather than tuning reconstruction thresholds. C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE remains HYPOTHESIS/EXPERIMENTAL at rule-based ceiling (bounded falsification for tested genuine adapter on tested orthogonal families/mixed/live, not global falsification of all semantic resolution). Sequencing saved live burn when synthetic gate fails.
estimated_cost: Low-moderate sequenced: Synthetic stage 70 tasks (40 alias-OOD orthogonal+mixed +12 exact +12 no-applicable +6 empty) x7 methods =490 deterministic kernel resolve+bind calls plus TF-IDF/embedding retrieval offline (<20 min CPU no LLM for RULE arm). LEARNED GRPO training adds 1-4h wall-clock if using local small LM (e.g., 7B) or hosted LLM ~300k-600k tokens for critique-reconstruct fine-tune with 3 seeds (42,43,44); report wall-clock/tokens/calls and CV. Live BrowserGym stage conditional on G0 pass: up to 50 live tasks (40 single +10 mixed) x7 methods =350 calls plus <50 Playwright navigations with CDP AX extraction at 1280x720 (<40 min if fixtures local, <6 min per 20 tasks). Sequencing avoids live cost if G0 fails (saves ~350 calls + browser time). Total compute <5h on single runner when live runs, <1.5h synthetic-only when gate fails, no large datasets committed, no giant raw data. Offline embedding local CPU. If LLM unavailable, LEARNED arm disclosed as unavailable and cost drops to <40 min synthetic-only.
expected_information_gain: Very high with sequencing economy: First valid test of learned GRPO/System-One vs rule-based genuine structural reconstruction with 3-seed stability/CV and calibrated ECE, and first orthogonal-family (header ApiKey/X-Reset-Token, body JSON field, auth permission) plus novel mixed multi-channel (header+body+query within one request) compositional generalization plus conditional live-browser WebShop/ALFWorld validation at BrowserGym 0.14.3 1280x720 with real CDP AX trees and production-SPA heterogeneity - directly addresses Director CONTINUE mandate with SUPERSEDE disposition and parent handoff's two dominant unknowns (learnability/training cost/stability and synthetic-to-real gap) plus compositional generalization, while respecting agent priors as priors not evidence (path dependence near past solutions, residual-novelty economics requiring discriminable boundaries, strong retrieval vs memory discrimination, orthogonal header/body channels). Either outcome changes product/architecture decision: positive validates retrieval+reconstruction vs exact matcher for broader aliasing and proves learnability unblocking cross-site transfer sequencing with calibrated abstention and measured economics; negative falsifies learned adaptation prior for orthogonal families/mixed/live or live generalization and cleanly parks semantic claim forcing pivot to compilation/synthesis, with sequencing gate preventing wasted live burn (high information per cost). Strong baselines (exact, verbatim, TFIDF, embed, random) and PC/NC with calibration gates (UNKNOWN precision, ECE) plus header/body/auth/mixed non-vacuous isolation and trajectory-grouped permutation ensure result not explained by retrieval strength, hallucination, or vacuous C4. Orthogonal to 30+ prior freshness/PMI/TV loops and to narrow URL-only POC (30/30 synthetic), satisfying frontier charter to leave solution basin. Reports training cost/stability and verification-boundary economics vs rule proxy and RAG for product decision.
